summary: String.includes tests whether a literal substring occurs in a string and returns a Boolean.
documentation: String.includes tests whether a literal substring occurs in a string and returns a Boolean. The search is case-sensitive and does not interpret regular-expression characters. The empty string is included in every string.
inputs: An object with texts (array of strings) and needle (string).
returns: One Boolean per text in input order.
caution: This checks substrings, not whole words or array membership. Passing a regular expression is an error; this exercise always supplies a string.
scenarios: Flag notes containing an agreed literal status marker.
Check filenames for a particular embedded label.
Preview substring matches while a user types in a local filter.
title: Find literal markers
problem: Input is {texts, needle}. Return a Boolean for each string indicating whether it contains needle. Keep matching case-sensitive and treat punctuation literally; an empty needle matches every text.
goal: Use String.includes() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
